testCases.label: object equals itself
testCases.description: Verifies that a SampleClass object correctly identifies itself as equal when compared using the equals method.

testCases.label: objects with same values are equal
testCases.description: Checks that two SampleClass objects with identical field values are considered equal.

testCases.label: objects with different 'a' value are not equal
testCases.description: Ensures that two SampleClass instances differing in field 'a' are evaluated as not equal.

testCases.label: objects with different 'b' value are not equal
testCases.description: Ensures that two SampleClass instances differing in field 'b' are evaluated as not equal.

testCases.label: object compared to null is not equal
testCases.description: Confirms that SampleClass.equals returns false when compared to null.

testCases.label: toString contains expected values (test 1)
testCases.description: Verifies that the SampleClass.toString output includes the correct values for a and b.

testCases.label: toString contains expected values (test 2)
testCases.description: Checks that the toString output contains the assigned values while excluding incorrect ones.

testCases.label: toString contains expected values (test 3)
testCases.description: Validates that toString properly includes the updated fields and omits values that do not match.

testCases.label: toString contains expected values (test 4)
testCases.description: Ensures that toString reflects the object's fields accurately, including boolean formatting.
